text:
alex: Heads-up: final run-through for Thurs 11:00 PDT (18:00 UTC) benchmark webinar. Need to confirm reg page, Zoom record settings, HS mapping, and post-event routing.

tara: Reg page is live at /events/llm-bench-2026. I added a short paragraph about sample workloads and a 1-click calendar CTA. HubSpot form mapped to fields: email, first_name, last_name, company, role, consent_checkbox. I left utm params dynamic.

jamal: Zoom: webinar ID 123-456-789. Cloud recording ON (speaker + gallery), auto-transcription ON, save to cloud in folder: Redwood/Events/2026-llm-bench. Alternative host: @ada. Disabled attendee auto-join; enable Q&A.

ada: I ran perms for the folder and gave marketing:edit, ops:view. Pushed stream key to 1Password at /secrets/events/llm-bench. Enabled "Original audio" and "record gallery view" in settings. Also toggled RTMP fallback for streaming in case Zoom cloud fails.

alex: Post-event plan: send three emails — immediate thank-you (with slides link), +48h replay note (30s highlight + transcript + CTA to download the benchmarking guide), +7d nurture with lighter excerpt + CTA to sign up for Dedicated trial. Tag everyone in HS with campaign=llm-bench-2026.

tara: Workflow in HubSpot: trigger on HS form submit -> wait 10m -> send confirmation + calendar invite -> track attendance via Zoom integration -> if attended > 3min tag as "attended" -> then wait 48h -> send replay email. Drafts are in HS > Marketing > Campaigns > LLMBench. Audience suppression list includes internal@redwood.com and past-attendees list.

jamal: Backup recordings: if cloud recording fails the RTMP fallback will stream to Vimeo account (vimeo@redwood) and also a local ops box will run a capture command. Added ffmpeg snippet to runbook: ```ffmpeg -i rtmp://vimeo/fallback -c copy /tmp/llm-bench-YYYYMMDD.mp4``` Also added a cron to rsync once recording is available.

ops-bot: [notice] Zoom webinar scheduled 2026-06-10T18:00:00Z. Cloud recording: enabled. Auto-transcription: enabled. RTMP fallback: enabled. Asset path: Redwood/Events/2026-llm-bench.

ada: Quick ask: can we produce a 30s clip of the throughput graph (0:50-1:20 in the slide vid)? Need closed captions and a 1-line alt text for accessibility. Jamal can you handle clip?

jamal: Yep. Will extract 30s, burn captions, export mp4 and upload to HubSpot file manager by Wed 23:00 UTC. Will also produce a 15s vertical clip for social.

alex: Owners: slides + host notes = @alex, clip + edit = @jamal, HS workflow + email copy = @tara, analytics + scoring = @ada. Confirm?

tara: Confirmed. I'll also add UTM parameters for the replay email and ensure the landing page for the guide has the campaign param.

ada: Analytics: set lead scoring rule: attendance > 10min + visited pricing page within 7 days -> score += 30 and alert SDR. I've added the scoring rule in HubSpot.

alex: Great. Last preflight: someone validate form GDPR checkbox behavior for EU registrants and make sure the calendar invite tz lines up. If green, I'll post the final checklist to the handbook and pin here. :rocket:
